author: nokipoki
quote:
Honestly, GTA VI is the worst GTA game in the series so far, at least in my opinion.

One of the biggest problems is how much freedom seems to have been removed. GTA has always been about doing whatever you want, stealing cars, causing chaos, exploring the world and creating your own fun. Even something as simple as stealing cars feels unnecessarily restricted and inefficient here.

Compare the opening of GTA V to GTA VI. GTA V immediately throws you into action with Michael, Trevor and Brad participating in a bank heist. The second protagonist introduction has Franklin and Lamar repossessing cars. You're immediately introduced to the criminal lifestyle that GTA is known for.

Meanwhile, some of the first activities in GTA VI involve getting Lucia flowers, fixing your house and buying groceries. Seriously? It feels incredibly slow, almost like playing a life simulator rather than Grand Theft Auto.

The driving is another major disappointment. It feels clunky, and I constantly find myself drifting even when I'm not trying to. Driving should feel natural and responsive, not like I'm fighting the controls every time I take a corner. It's worse than GTA IV's driving

My biggest issue is that GTA seems to have lost some of its identity. I don't want every little activity to feel scripted or restricted. I want the freedom to jump into a random car, drive wherever I want, cause chaos and create my own experiences.

GTA has always been about freedom, action and unpredictability. So far, GTA VI feels like it's moving in the opposite direction.
